cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: connect a first signal, changed clue, bridge detail, and return note across one scene chain
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for one made-up moss message observatory page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one blank page, this card, and three labeled paper pocket slips for start scene, next scene, and return detail: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up an observatory helper, a moss signal, and a pretend page where the scene chain changes one clue at a time: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the first observatory moment, including the helper, the moss signal color, and where the signal waits on the chart rail: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the signal table and show what new moss mark appears beside the first chart note: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one concrete bridge detail, such as a pebble lens, folded chart corner, or whisper-quiet signal flag, that links both scenes: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write the exact clue change, such as the moss mark turning from a dot to a tiny arrow on the pretend page: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first moss signal and explain how the changed mark helps the helper read it more clearly: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: place one sentence in the expanding file paper pocket that names the start scene clue and the return detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to the moss signal, and the writer fills only the bridge detail and return detail blanks: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: continue a paper-only observatory scene chain by saving one pretend signal note in a paper pocket: ____________________.

cards.title: Pantry Measurement Mystery Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: carry a measurement clue from one shelf scene to the next without breaking the pretend mystery
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for one made-up pantry measurement mystery page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a blank page beside the expanding file and label one paper pocket for the first measure clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a pretend shelf keeper, a measuring ribbon, and a made-up mystery that stays on paper: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the first shelf moment where the helper finds a measuring ribbon with three odd tick marks: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move the helper to the tally shelf and show which tick mark does not match the pretend jar label row: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one specific link between scenes, such as a bent ruler edge, chalk tally strip, or paper jar tag with a tiny square: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write how the clue changes when the helper compares two pretend measurements on the page: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first measuring ribbon and show how its odd tick mark finally points to the right paper tag: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: tuck a one-line measurement clue into the expanding file paper pocket for this scene chain: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult names the first tick mark, and the writer writes only the next scene and return detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: make another paper-only measurement mystery by carrying one pretend ribbon clue from page to paper pocket: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Map Room Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: use a map-room clue to bridge two scenes and return to the first page detail
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for one made-up seed library map room page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set the expanding file open, add one blank page, and label a paper pocket for the map-room bridge detail: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: create a pretend map guide, a drawer map, and a made-up scene chain that follows one folded path clue: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write how the map guide opens a drawer map and finds one folded path clue beside a seed label stamp: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the long map table and show how the folded path points to a different drawer mark than expected: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one concrete object that links the scenes, such as a brass drawer pull, dotted path strip, or stamped corner square: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write the moment the path clue changes direction on the pretend page after the guide flips one map flap: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first drawer map and show how the changed path clue makes its first mark useful: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: file one map-room bridge sentence in the expanding file paper pocket for later page planning: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult chooses the drawer map detail, and the writer fills only the change marker blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep a paper-only map room scene chain by carrying one folded clue from start scene to return detail: ____________________.

cards.title: Pond Bridge Blueprint Club Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: show a blueprint idea changing between two scenes while one bridge detail returns
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for one made-up pond bridge blueprint club page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out a blank page, the expanding file, and a paper pocket labeled blueprint clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: make up a bridge planner, a pretend pond blueprint, and a scene chain where one sketch detail changes: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the first blueprint club moment where the planner draws a tiny bridge sketch beside a pebble marker: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the paper model table and show what part of the bridge sketch needs a new line or label: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one concrete bridge detail, such as a plank notch, lily-pad stamp, or folded blueprint flap, that connects the scenes: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write how the sketch changes from first idea to clearer paper plan while keeping the work calm and adult-led: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first pebble marker and show how the updated sketch now explains its place: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: place one blueprint change sentence in the expanding file paper pocket for this pretend scene chain: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult circles one sketch detail, and the writer writes only the change marker and return detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: build another paper-only blueprint scene chain by saving one sketch clue in a paper pocket: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: manage a longer ferry scene chain by tracking revision choices, bridge details, and a returning clue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for one made-up revision river ferry page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out two blank pages, the expanding file, and a paper pocket labeled ferry revision clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: invent a pretend ferry helper, a folded ticket clue, and a scene chain that revises one river crossing idea on paper: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write the first ferry moment where the helper finds a folded ticket with one unclear dock symbol: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: move to the ferry desk and show how the helper tries a clearer sentence for the dock symbol on the next page: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one concrete bridge detail, such as a ticket crease, bell cord note, or folded ferry map edge, that ties the scenes together: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write the exact revision choice that changes the crossing idea, such as replacing a vague clue with a clearer paper symbol: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the folded ticket and show how the revised symbol now makes the ferry scene chain easier to follow: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: file one ferry revision sentence in the expanding file paper pocket so the returning clue stays connected: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult marks the folded ticket clue, and the writer writes only the revised symbol sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: continue a paper-only ferry scene chain by saving one pretend revision clue in a paper pocket: ____________________.
